description: Source code implementing Diffie-Hellman key exchange and cryptographic key derivation functions using OpenSSL, including serialization/deserialization of keys and secret derivation, with specific focus on DiffieHellman and Netflix-specific key derivation.

classes.name: KeyStore
classes.description: Handles serialization and deserialization of Diffie-Hellman and BIGNUM keys, interfacing with a Vault for secure storage.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes BIGNUM, DH, or raw key data into the vault.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes keys from the vault into BIGNUM or DH structures.

methods.name: GenerateDiffieHellmanKeys
methods.description: Generates Diffie-Hellman key pair with specified generator and modulus, stores keys in vault.

methods.name: DiffieHellmanDeriveSecret
methods.description: Computes shared secret from private and peer public keys.

methods.name: DiffieHellmanDeriveSecret
methods.description: Derives shared secret using stored keys, outputs secret ID.

methods.name: DiffieHellmanAuthenticatedDeriveSecret
methods.description: Performs authenticated Diffie-Hellman key derivation, producing encryption, HMAC, and wrapping keys.
